bioconda.name: virusdetect
bioconda.summary: Python rewrite of the VirusDetect plant virus discovery pipeline

commands: python -c "import shutil; required = ['bwa', 'samtools', 'blastn', 'blastx', 'makeblastdb', 'hisat2', 'hisat2-build', 'spades.py', 'velveth', 'velvetg']; missing = [name for name in required if shutil.which(name) is None]; assert not missing, missing"
